# SubtleTea Solutions

## Sustainable compute, private AI, and social intelligence {#subtitle}

<div id="hero-photo">
  <img src="images/circle-logo-teacup-nowordmark.png"/>
</div>

SubtleTea Solutions develops computational infrastructure, products, and
software that are **more lucrative because they are more sustainable**.

Big tech companies and talking heads act like compute resources and artificial
intelligence server farms are acts of God, and not the creations of mankind they
really are.

Seeing this open niche for efficient, cost-effective, and private
computing, SubtleTea Solutions started to develop
new advanced tech that fully exploits the most efficient, affordable
computers available today.
Artificial intelligence assistants can run locally, _privately_, on this
specialized hardware, and be special tuned to _enhance_, and not _replace_, human
abilities and cooperation.

---

Much of our efforts are currently going towards supporting the launch of our
sister non-profit, the [Generation of Participation in
Democracy](https://gpdamericas.org), and its inaugural Flagship Institute, the
[_Instituto Dourados_](https://institutodourados.org).

Efficient, reliable tech that can be deployed anywhere, like an Indigenous
reservation in Brazil, has the potential to rapidly accelerate capacity building
towards self-sufficiency and independence in historically marginalized
communities.

The second half of 2026 should be exciting with software and product launches in
our line of Sustainable Inference software and hardware, so please stay tuned.

Please follow our new [LinkedIn
page](https://linkedin.com/company/subtletea-solutions), which will soon
begin providing regular updates, with weekly or greater frequency. Even if you
don't use LinkedIn much, if you follow us it helps boost us in the algorithm.

Thanks for your interest and support!

<hr>

**Please Note:** Founder and CEO Matt Turner currently has limited availability
for consulting engagements starting August 1, 2026. Please [email for more
information](mailto:matt@mat.phd).
